latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the replication-failure-analyzer skill for diagnosing active replication failures across common topologies.
- Maps symptoms such as read-after-write violations, monotonic reads violations, and split brain to failure classes: leader failover pitfalls, replication lag anomalies, and quorum edge cases.
- Accepts codebase/config files or verbal incident descriptions; produces a structured analysis report with failure classification, mechanism identification, and recommended mitigations.
- Supports environments including PostgreSQL, MySQL (single-leader), Cassandra, Riak, Voldemort, and DynamoDB (leaderless).
- Includes references and boundaries for related diagnostic skills such as replication-strategy-selector and distributed-failure-analyzer.
